visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera points downward at a light blue striped dress shirt laid out on a grey sofa. Hands enter the frame and place khaki trousers, a dark blazer, and a navy/red striped tie on top of the shirt in sequence. (2) A middle-aged man with short black hair appears in a medium shot inside a living room with brown curtains. He is putting on the light blue striped shirt and meticulously fastening the front buttons while looking slightly off-camera. (3) He holds the folded khaki trousers up to the camera lens, then the scene cuts to him stepping into the pants and pulling them up over his waist. He then threads a black leather belt through the loops and tightens it. (4) He bends down out of frame and picks up a small, long-haired brown dachshund. He brings the dog's face close to the camera, smiling warmly as the dog looks around. (5) He focuses on his wrists, fastening the silver cufflinks on his shirt sleeves before adjusting his white collar in the mirror. (6) A series of close-up insert shots show his hands tying the striped tie using a four-in-hand knot. A small adhesive bandage is visible on his index finger as he carefully loops and pulls the fabric. (7) He tightens the tie knot at his neck and turns down his collar. He then holds up a silver luxury watch to show the face before strapping it onto his left wrist. (8) He puts on the dark blazer, smoothing the shoulders and buttoning the front. He stands fully dressed in a complete professional outfit, smiling confidently at the camera with his hands in his pockets.
